archetype: Electric & Neon + Swiss & High-Contrast (Investor-Grade / Command Center)
design_philosophy: A premium dark control-room dashboard. Technical, futurist, dense, and precise. No generic SaaS aesthetics. No purple/blue AI templates. No playful rounded bubbles.

layout_and_spacing.app_shell: 100vh fixed layout on desktop with independent scrolling panels. Bottom nav for mobile. Collapsible/adaptive side rail for tablet.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal drop shadows. Rely on subtle 1px borders and inner neon glows for active states.
visual_enhancers.gradients: BANNED: Purple/Blue gradients. PERMITTED: Very subtle black-to-graphite linear gradients (bg-gradient-to-b from-[#111113] to-[#0A0A0B]) for panels.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-border_subtle. Active/selected elements use border-primary_accent with primary_accent_glow box-shadow.
visual_enhancers.3d_effect: Central stage should use high-contrast imagery or CSS wireframe visuals glowing in highlight_accent (Orange).

avatars.description: Primary user avatar in top nav

property.description: Thumbnail for Villa Horizon in the left nav

3d_assets.description: Blueprint/wireframe architecture to be used in the central 3D digital twin stage if R3F/Spline isn't implemented. Apply a CSS filter to give it an orange thermal glow.

top_nav.layout: Flex horizontal, h-14, sticky top-0, z-50, border-b border-[#27272A].
top_nav.brand: STRATEX (bold white) HABITAT™ (neon teal). Hexagon logo.
top_nav.elements: ⌘K search bar, Notification bell, Profile chip (avatar, name, role).

left_sidebar.layout: Flex horizontal. Thin vertical icon rail on extreme left (cube, chart, ruler, doc, dollar, folder, people, shield, gear, help). Wider section nav panel next to it.
left_sidebar.sections: TWIN, INTELLIGENCE, DESIGN & PLAN, PROCUREMENT, DOCUMENTS.
left_sidebar.property_card: Top of section nav. Thumbnail, 'Villa Horizon', 'Austin TX', Connected green dot.

center_stage.kpi_cards: Row of status cards. Property Score 87/100 (ring), Energy Efficiency 72, Water Efficiency 64, System Health 91, Maintenance Alerts 3 Active. Use JetBrains Mono for numbers.
center_stage.3d_twin_area: Large central area. Use a glowing neon wireframe representation (orange thermal glow). Floating Layers toggle panel overlay (Thermal, Energy Flow, Water Flow, Structural, Electrical, Plumbing, HVAC, Roofing).
center_stage.bottom_analytics: Row of cards (Monthly Energy Cost, Water Usage, System Uptime, Carbon Footprint) with sparklines and % change.

right_inspector.layout: w-80 or w-96 flex-shrink-0 flex vertical gap-4 border-l border-[#27272A] p-4 overflow-y-auto.
right_inspector.content: SELECTED ASSET (Roof - North Slope), CONDITION bar, AI FINDING (priority badge), RECOMMENDED ACTIONS (price range + Request Quote button in neon teal), TOP CONTRACTOR QUOTES list (avatar, star ratings, prices).

testing.data_testid: ALL interactive elements, buttons, inputs, links, navigation items, and major KPI text MUST have a data-testid attribute using kebab-case role-based naming (e.g., 'nav-twin-link', 'kpi-property-score', 'action-request-quote').

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use 'lucide-react' for all icons (cube, chart, ruler, etc.).
Install and use 'recharts' for the bottom analytics sparklines.
Implement the layout with strict technical styling. Avoid generous padding; use compact density.

For the central 3D Twin render, if a 3D library (like three.js or react-three-fiber) is too complex for an MVP, use the provided '3d_assets' image URL with a custom CSS styling (mix-blend-mode, sepia, hue-rotate) to achieve an orange thermal glow over a dark background.
Ensure 'STRATEX' is font-bold text-white and 'HABITAT™' is text-[#14F1D9].
Make sure the app shell handles responsive states: desktop (full sidebars), tablet (adaptive rail), mobile (stacked cards, bottom nav).
Strictly adhere to the dark graphite panels (bg-[#111113]) and 1px borders (border-[#27272A]) for the 'investor-grade control room' look.
